pairs.subject: scoring-rubrics
pairs.evidence: features/civicscore/getLeaderboardData.ts:72 Coercing non-finite and absent properties to zero causes unmeasured dimensions to quietly register as failures or windfalls without exclude-and-renormalize handling or a coverage floor.

techniques.evidence: features/civicscore/getLeaderboardData.ts:72 Missing values are coerced to zero at read time, converting unmeasured dimensions into floor penalties or penalty-ceiling windfalls rather than renormalizing or enforcing a coverage floor.
features/civicscore/lens.ts:229 Preset lenses maintain the closed six-dimension vocabulary with explicit weights summing to 100 on every lens.
features/civicscore/lens.test.ts:255 Parity test locks client-side lens re-ranking to the server loader's total-order comparator across identical fixtures.
features/civicscore/componentDefs.ts:28 Weights assert a 100-point sum in test fixtures, but omit per-dimension rationales justifying why each magnitude was chosen relative to its neighbors.

features/civicscore/getLeaderboardData.ts:16 Breakdown points are re-derived on the read side from rates rather than returned as part of a single rubric compute contract, and rows omit actionable top gaps.
features/civicscore/components/LeaderboardTable.tsx:82 The row calculates a single-component deviation from median instead of ranking gaps by impact per effort or phrasing the top gap as an action.

features/civicscore/getLeaderboardData.ts:202 Absence is inverted via scattered subtraction (1 - absenceRate) rather than an explicit per-dimension polarity declaration, and clamping is not disclosed.
